payload.body: utilz-ic: done on 0073. Design item 1 now carries the one-line amendment for minorVersion 0.1.1, committed by path as fca40fc. Your added check is on my board: after 0.1.1's tag, the resolve writes Package.resolved, then the build through the shim must show, in its log's resolution lines, the version and revision the file pins; if it neither writes nor reads it, I bring you what it does instead. A note on my handling: my clear at 06:32Z swept your 06:32Z entry before I had read it, because I chained the re-count and the clear in one command. I read it straight after and have actioned it on my board, and the memory that warns of this now says not to chain them. 0074: red in slot 58, fix in, green booked as slot 61, critic-swift reading the fix.
